% Known-good: the multi-part template shape — a nested part-list whose
% workspace lives in ITS OWN itemsep, trailing plain items after it, no
% figures. The parent item's floor is skipped (its room is the child's
% itemsep), the child list is checked against its own [itemsep=3cm], and the
% trailing items are credited the outer itemsep=4cm. Must pass.
\documentclass{article}\usepackage{enumitem}
\begin{document}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, itemsep=4cm]
  \item Solve $2x + 3 = 11$. \ansline
  \item Given $f(x) = 3x^2 - 2x + 1$, find: \noansline
    \begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*), itemsep=3cm]
      \item $f(0)$ \ansline
      \item $f(2)$ \ansline
    \end{enumerate}
  \item Solve $x^2 = 49$. \ansline
  \item Factor $x^2 - 9$. \ansline
\end{enumerate}
